long_biography.plain_text:
A decade in Brazil placed Jes Staley inside J.P. Morgan's Latin American corporate-finance and brokerage businesses early in his banking career. He later helped establish the bank's equities operation, then ran its private bank, asset-management division and investment bank.

That progression preceded Staley's appointment as Barclays group chief executive. At J.P. Morgan he had expanded asset management into alternative investments, including a strategic partnership with Highbridge Capital Management. Outside banking, he served as a Bowdoin College trustee and supported HIV/AIDS organisations alongside his activist brother Peter. Gay Men's Health Crisis honoured the brothers for work that joined institutional leadership with a personal family commitment.
